name: hades
description: Score the oral drug-likeness of small molecules from SMILES with HADES (Holistic AI-based Drug-likeness Estimation Score), a soft-voting ensemble over Mordred, ADMET-AI and QED descriptors, served as a local MCP tool.

python.title: Python interpreter of the hades conda environment
python.description: Absolute path to python in the conda environment built from environment.yml, with the MCP SDK added (see the HADES README). Write it out in full; ~ is not expanded. For example /home/you/miniconda3/envs/hades/bin/python or C:/Users/you/miniconda3/envs/hades/python.exe. Print it with: conda run -n hades python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"
